scientific_integrity: Continuum proof from backward moment equations and exact Dirichlet–Neumann resolvents; independent symbolic, Green quadrature and finite-amplitude Hermite discretization checks. Results remain subject to external replication and literature review.
scientific_limitations: Local, linear weak-amplitude response for a Brownian–OU particle on the unit reflecting–absorbing interval; resets return both position and a prescribed small velocity. No uniqueness of the relaxation-rate sign-crossing, finite-reset-rate optimum, nonperturbative velocity claim, or growing-domain theorem.
title: Persistence reverses the fixed-velocity contribution to the onset of beneficial resetting
